group: The gods would agree with me
text: Rigroth the Undying would NOT support sentry staves. Just saying.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: K'Or'Arath would never let someone use homing bullets in his presence. He'd want you to aim. With your heart.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: You think Vorrath of the Thousand Teeth would leave the campfire unlit? I don't think so, {Mate}.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Ul'Thazhra the Unblinking would never put a Wooden Arrow in the armory. She has standards.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Mother Gnash would never give the summoners a raise. She'd give it to us. She told me.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Ixxethra the Star-Eater would never skip a Blood Moon. Some of us do our part.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: The Drowned One would never reforge a sword nine times for one prefix. The Drowned One accepts what the anvil gives.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Rigroth the Undying fought the first Wall of Flesh with a Copper Shortsword. He would not respect your Zenith, {Mate}.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: K'Or'Arath would never park his minion in front of the door. Think about others.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Vorrath of the Thousand Teeth would not tolerate a summoner in the front row. Back row only. Like he said.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: If Ul'Thazhra the Unblinking saw how you're wearing that armor, {Mate}, she'd blink. And she has never blinked.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Mother Gnash would never pay the Tax Collector. She'd eat him. But respectfully.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Rigroth the Undying didn't die ten thousand times for you to turn on autoswing, {Mate}.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: The old gods walked to every biome. No pylons. Think about that next time you teleport.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Ixxethra would never take the last Lesser Healing Potion. Ixxethra is a team player.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Do you think K'Or'Arath would hand his staff to an imp and call it a day? No. He'd hold it. Because he cares.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Rigroth the Undying would never throw a perfectly good sword into the Shimmer. He'd say 'that was a gift.' That was a gift, {Mate}.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: The Drowned One would never put a dirt wall in front of a perfectly good arena. The Drowned One builds with stone.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Vorrath would never let a drone sleep in the barracks. Drones sleep outside. Like in the old days.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Ul'Thazhra would never bring a flail to a worm fight. I'm not saying who did. I'm saying she wouldn't.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Mother Gnash would want you to tip the Nurse. Even after she charged you for a respawn. Especially then.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Rigroth the Undying would never send a mage into a boss fight without a snack. Feed your mages, {Mate}.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: K'Or'Arath doesn't believe in Ammo Boxes. He believes in carrying your own ammo. Uphill. In the Underworld.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: Ixxethra the Star-Eater would never complain about mana while hoarding Fallen Stars. He'd eat them. Like a responsible god.

group: The gods would agree with me
text: The ancient ones are very clear on this. If you use homing bullets, you're basically a summoner.
